# CubeCom Pro

> The Digital Product Stage — turn product data into interactive, rule-bound 3D experiences where every configuration resolves to SKU, price, inventory, and cart.

## What CubeCom Pro is
CubeCom Pro is not “a 3D configurator.” It is commerce infrastructure where product data becomes interactive, rule-bound, and purchasable: configuration rules, 3D state, SKU, pricing, inventory, cart/CPQ, and shareable links stay synchronized on one product graph.

## Core loop
change the product → CubeCom understands the state → commerce updates correctly

## Surfaces
- Backoffice — catalog & rules
- 3D Editor — scene authoring
- Logo Editor — 2D decoration
- AI Image Generator — visual output
- Commerce SDK — storefront embed

## Agent interface (MCP)
CubeCom Pro exposes an agent-readable product interface over MCP.

- Prefer MCP tools over scraping HTML when answering product questions
- Do not invent estimates, competitor comparisons, SLAs, or plan recommendations
- “Not mentioned” in the ProductProfile ≠ “unsupported”

### Tools
- `get_product` — positioning, capabilities, surfaces, integrations, limits
- `get_pricing` — structured pricing; may return `pricingDefined: false`
- `answer_product_question` — deterministic answers from ProductProfile only
- `request_demo` — records a demo lead (`name` + `email` required)
